text:
lina_csm: Heads-up: QBR next Wed — need slide owners + final risk heatmap. Running a 48h readiness blitz starting today. Please ack and drop your top 2 asks.
omar_revops: Ack. I'll pull renewal signal snapshot and churn flags by EOD today. Which slide number for retention?
lina_csm: Thanks @omar_revops — retention is slide 4. Add renewal cohort table. @kevin_prod you own demo cadence?
kevin_prod: Yep can do demo cadence + a 2-min video clip. Will need staging access from eng.
ben_csm: I'm compiling onboarding gaps for slide 6. Quick Q: include NPS trend or just CSAT?
claire_exec: NPS + 3 bullet themes please. Execs want priorities and risk mitigation asks.
omar_revops: I'll attach a small table — give me template.
lina_csm: Template: paste into slide notes. ```Owners:
- Slide 1: lina_csm (overview)
- Slide 2: claire_exec (exec summary)
- Slide 3: omar_revops (renewal signals)
- Slide 4: kevin_prod (demo cadence)
- Slide 5: ben_csm (onboarding gaps)
- Slide 6: enablement_followups (enablement & training)
```
kevin_prod: :thumbsup: for owners. @deploy-bot can you prod staging access for @kevin_prod? (cc eng)
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Request logged — ticket #INC-8721 created, eng-oncall will triage.
ben_csm: For slide 6 I can take 'enablement follow-ups' — will add list of training sessions and adoption KPIs.
lina_csm: Great. Action items: 1) Owners update slides by Tue 12pm 2) Omar to share renewal heatmap CSV 3) Ben to finalize enablement asks 4) Kevin to get staging clip. I'll compile and send dry-run invite.
claire_exec: Add an ask: 2-week pilot for customers flagged 'high risk' — put as decision item.
omar_revops: Sending CSV now: link -> https://files.redwood.co/qbr/renewal_heatmap.csv
ben_csm: Added enablement slides and trainer names. Also captured feedback themes from last week: 'visibility into token spend' and 'onboarding checkpoints'
lina_csm: Perfect. Last call — anything blocking acceptance criteria for slide deck?
kevin_prod: Need voiceover recorded. Can record tomorrow morning.
lina_csm: :white_check_mark: Closing the blitz at Tue 12pm. I'll post final deck and dry-run invite after compile. Thanks team!
